description: She wears an ivory floor-length long-sleeved dress with a high square neckline and gold embroidered front panel beneath a brown-gold flowing outer garment with rich geometric and floral borders. A decorated waist belt with round metal fittings, gold necklace, small earrings and rings complement the dress. Long opaque sleeves reach the wrists and the unbroken skirt covers the legs; gold-brown shoes show at the hem. No headgear, armor or weapons are visible.
